paired_positive_population: Physical operational episodes that are uniquely mapped in the concatenated OOF score rows and have at least one ELIGIBLE_ONSET_POSITIVE issue in those score rows.
occurrence_view_within_paired_population: For each selected physical episode, retain every uniquely mapped positive occurrence window belonging to that episode; this preserves repeated-window multiplicity for the standard occurrence estimand.
episode_normalized_view_within_paired_po: Use the same retained occurrence windows but divide each selected episode's total positive statistical mass equally so that the episode sums to 1.
onset_view_within_paired_population: Use only ELIGIBLE_ONSET_POSITIVE rows from the same selected physical episodes plus the common onset-eligible negative rows.
negative_population: All scored interval-negative rows grouped into contiguous UTC Monday-anchored 7-day quiet blocks; the same sampled quiet-block indices are reused across views and models, with each view applying its predeclared eligibility mask.
ambiguous_positive_windows: Excluded from paired physical-unit inference and retained only in full-window descriptive results.
reason: This keeps the physical positive events identical across standard, episode-normalized, and onset contrasts, so a cross-view difference is not caused by sampling a different set of storms.
